authority.owner_direction: Cut the verifier down to what the three-probe Stage A gate cannot prove.

retained_assertions: Exact temporary endpoint and security-group existence and identity
Exact endpoint policy documents and their allowed actions and resources
All three endpoint states must be available
The S3 gateway endpoint must bind the exact approved route table
The AWS-managed S3 prefix-list identity must resolve through DescribePrefixLists
Exactly three consecutive private probe launches must pass before any full window unlocks
deleted_assertion_classes: Interface endpoint security-group response shape and attachment membership
Security-group ingress and egress permission grouping and per-rule wiring
Terraform expression-reference wiring for endpoint security groups and the S3 prefix list
rationale: Three consecutive private Fargate tasks must pull the exact digest through the temporary ECR and S3 endpoints and start successfully. This directly proves the complete connectivity chain. Retaining response-shape assertions for the same chain adds failure modes without adding evidence. Policy documents and the S3 gateway route table remain checked because a successful pull does not prove least-privilege policy or route-table scope.
